Chapter 1177: Chapter 2 Breakthrough (Subscription Request)

"Venerable, what do you call the Galaxy?"

Xia Qin Supreme suppressed the astonishment in his heart, even though he was sure he hadn’t misheard.

Even a Chaos Realm being like Ancient Ming Venerable couldn’t get it wrong, but he still wanted to confirm it again.

Galaxy Great Saint?

In the Chaos Void, among various Void Domains, the titles for powerful beings are numerous, but a Great Saint?

Only those who have reached the perfection of the Chaos Realm and evolved their own chaotic theoretical path are qualified to be called a Great Saint.

Without reaching this level, to presumptively regard oneself as a Great Saint would bring great calamity.

Xuanyuan Supreme and several other Supremes also looked towards Ancient Ming Venerable.

They held their breath, not daring to make a sound.

"It seems you still don’t know?"

Seeing this, Ancient Ming Venerable suddenly understood.

It seems that the Galaxy Great Saint had not revealed his true power to Xuanyuan Supreme and the others.

Indeed.

If they had known Galaxy Great Saint’s strength, how could the human tribes of the Star Tear Fragment World be so low-profile?

As for what happened on the side of the Xuanhuang Universe, it was at most circulated among the Venerables.

Below the Venerable level? Very few know about it.

Of course.

As time goes by.

The renown of the Galaxy Great Saint will spread across various Void Domains.

"Galaxy Great Saint..."

Ancient Ming Venerable recounted what he knew.

Even if he didn’t say it now, in just a few months, the news would spread here.

Since the Galaxy Great Saint displayed his power in front of many Venerables, he probably didn’t intend to keep it hidden anymore.

"Are you saying that outside that Postnatal Universe, Galaxy withstood Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and many other Great Saints?"

Xia Qin Supreme was dumbfounded. Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint were well-known formidable Great Saints. Originally, Ancient Ming Venerable’s title for Lin Yuan had him merely guessing that Lin Yuan might have reached the perfection of the Chaos Realm.

But to withstand Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint? That’s not as simple as being merely in the perfection of the Chaos Realm.

"How could Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint compare to Galaxy Great Saint? Within the Postnatal Universe, Galaxy Great Saint suppressed Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and six other Chaos Great Saints. Only Dual Origin Great Saint managed to escape."

Ancient Ming Venerable said.

Upon hearing this.

The minds of several Supremes of human civilization were in a muddle.

Suppressing eight Chaos Great Saints? Including strong Great Saints like Black Light Great Saint and Wild Barbarian Great Saint?

To defeat and to suppress are completely different in difficulty, with the latter being much tougher.

"Venerable, how did you come to know about this? Could it be a misinformation? Like the same name?"

Xia Qin Supreme immediately said; it’s not that he didn’t believe in Lin Yuan’s strength, it was just too unbelievable. How long has human civilization been in the Chaos Void?

The strength of several human civilization Supremes showed little change, yet Lin Yuan had become a Chaos Great Saint? And an invincible one among Chaos Great Saints?

"It is not a misinformation."

Ancient Ming Venerable assured.

How could there be such coincidences?

And in the subsequent times, from the image frames Ancient Ming Venerable received, it was almost confirmed that the Galaxy Great Saint was indeed Lin Yuan.

"Is the Great Saint available now?"

Asked Ancient Ming Venerable, not forgetting his purpose of coming here, which was to seek an audience with Lin Yuan.

"I’ll go ask now."

Xuanyuan Supreme barely collected himself and immediately inquired Lin Yuan, moments later, he nodded towards Ancient Ming Venerable and said, "Come in."

"Alright."

Ancient Ming Venerable was elated and immediately walked into the Star Tear Fragment World.

After Ancient Ming Venerable went to see Lin Yuan.

Supremes like Xia Qin and the others of the human civilization tribes were still standing there, not yet fully recovering from the news about Galaxy Great Saint.

"Galaxy truly became a Great Saint?"

Xia Qin Supreme muttered to himself.

"It should be true."

Feather Butterfly Supreme nodded.

Although up until now, they hadn’t heard from other channels about Lin Yuan becoming a Chaos Great Saint.

But from Ancient Ming Venerable’s cautious and genuinely respectful demeanor just now, it seemed unlikely to be false.

Ancient Ming Venerable is a seasoned Venerable; who else aside from a true Chaos Great Saint could command such respectful deference from him?

"Unexpectedly, our human civilization actually produced a Chaos Great Saint?" The Void God Ultimate Being exclaimed in astonishment.

If they were still in their home universe, they might not consider a Chaos Great Saint all that impressive because they couldn’t truly grasp what being a Chaos Great Saint meant.

But after entering the Chaos Void, especially with Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent being a base for years, the Supremes of human civilization realized the more they saw, the better they understood certain forbidden truths.

Let alone a Great Saint, even just a Chaos Venerable would be an unattainable supreme for them.

And now, their human civilization actually birthed a Great Saint?

"Don’t attribute it solely to the human civilization tribe; Galaxy becoming a Great Saint doesn’t have much to do with human civilization." Xia Qin Supreme spoke with a slight sigh, "With Galaxy’s talent, no matter where he is, he would rise. We should be grateful that Galaxy appeared in our human civilization tribe."

"Indeed."

Several Supremes nodded.

Aside from some assistance provided to Lin Yuan before his formation of the twelfth layer, it was entirely reciprocation to human civilization afterward.

Without Lin Yuan, with the Great Cosmic Catastrophe arriving earlier, how many could human civilization survive? How many Supremes could survive? One, two, or three?

Even if they could endure the Great Cosmic Catastrophe, how many could escape when facing looters waiting outside the universe?

Entering the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, human civilization has always survived under Lin Yuan’s protection. Without Lin Yuan, how could there be a new home like the Star Tear Fragment World with such favorable conditions?

...

"Greetings, Galaxy Great Saint."

The Ancient Ming Venerable saw the Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit and respectfully saluted.

"Mm."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

With his current strength, there was completely no need to remain hidden.

"Is the Great Saint preparing to establish a new Chaos Continent?"

After some flattering words, the Ancient Ming Venerable probingly asked.

Previously, although the Ancient Ming Venerable speculated that Lin Yuan was the reincarnation of some Great Saint, his strength was still at the Chaos Realm Venerable level at that time.

So, while Lin Yuan resided on the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, the Ancient Ming Venerable felt considerable pressure, it was still bearable.

But now?

Lin Yuan revealed a level of an Invincible Chaos Great Saint, and the Ancient Ming Venerable immediately felt unprecedented pressure.

Like an ant beside a giant dragon, fearing that a single breath from the dragon would blow the ant far away.

"Establish a Chaos Continent?"

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment. Normally, Chaos Realm experts would establish a Chaos Continent.

Firstly, as their own domain, secondly, the process of establishing a Chaos Continent is also a review of their understanding of rules.

Many Chaos Venerables and even Chaos Great Saints often establish more than one Chaos Continent.

As for the Absolute Great Saints, they would attempt to establish a Postnatal Universe.

"In some time, I will establish one."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Establishing a Chaos Continent now, and after stepping into the Absolute Great Saint, using the Chaos Continent as a foundation to establish a Postnatal Universe, isn’t considered a wasteful repetition.

"With the Great Saint’s strength, once the Chaos Continent is established, it will likely attract several thousand or ten thousand Void Domain experts from the surroundings," the Ancient Ming Venerable said.

The stronger the expert who establishes a Chaos Continent, the more prosperous it will be. Of course, here the experts referred to are the orderly ones.

As for those extreme Venerable Saints, few dare to go to the Chaos Continents they establish.

Based on the Ancient Ming Venerable’s understanding of Lin Yuan, it was certain this Great Saint wasn’t the capricious type. In such a case, the Chaos Continent established would definitely be very popular.

The Ancient Ming Venerable even considered moving next to the Chaos Continent Lin Yuan would establish, enjoying both safety and benefits.

...

Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion in Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

In the depths of space, time and space began to warp and rotate.

Lin Yuan’s figure emerged from it.

"I’m back."

Lin Yuan glanced around, immediately confirming his return to the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent through the Taiyin Primordial Spirit’s resonance.

"I hope you will keep this secret for me."

Lin Yuan said to the reformed Eye of Myriad Laws.

His gains within the Xuanhuang Universe were tremendous. Outsiders wouldn’t suspect his connections with the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, but once known, it might attract the attention of some Absolute Great Saints.

"Rest assured, I also do not wish for you to encounter any trouble."

The Eye of Myriad Laws replied immediately. It could be said that the Chaos Void most hoped for Lin Yuan’s smooth growth to the pinnacle as it was a unique existence.

Only in this way could the Eye of Myriad Laws retrieve its early investment.

Before this, the Eye of Myriad Laws would even take the initiative to protect Lin Yuan and resolve troubles.

...

Deep in the Star Tear Fragment World.

Lin Yuan’s true form appeared.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit rose and merged into Lin Yuan’s body voluntarily.

"Finally back."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, his mind at ease.

This Xuanhuang Universe journey brought him unprecedented gains as the entire accumulation of the Invincible Great Saint Xuanhuang was bestowed upon Lin Yuan.

"This cauldron."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts, flipping his right hand, revealing a small cauldron shrouded in a hazy glow.

The small cauldron was only palm-sized, without any aura leakage, but Lin Yuan knew this was due to the hazy glow sealing it.

The essence of the hazy glow, is the limitless power of time looping.

Only such power, at the thirteen-tier strength, could barely seal this thirteen-tier weapon.

"Your Majesty mentioned this small cauldron can be comprehended."

Lin Yuan cautiously extended a trace of his mind into the small cauldron.

The hazy glow sealing the cauldron did not obstruct Lin Yuan’s mind.

Buzz buzz buzz.

In the small cauldron, Lin Yuan felt incredibly vast rules.

Immense like the sea, intricate and perfect, no less than the entirety of the Chaos Void rules circulating and flowing within the cauldron.

"Space-time?"

At the same time, Lin Yuan felt the two dominant pillar rules inside the cauldron, time and space.

The boundless vast rules primarily revolved around these two rules.

"This?"

A substantial amount of insight burst forth in Lin Yuan’s mind, transforming his previous accumulation of space-time understanding into qualitative change.

In an instant, the space-time before Lin Yuan began to dramatically and fundamentally transform.
